replies.What is your relationship with mathemati: Mathematics has always been a challenging yet rewarding subject for me. I find joy in solving problems and uncovering patterns, but also experience anxiety when faced with complex equations or proofs.
replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Yes, especially during high-pressure situations like exams or when tackling unfamiliar problems. The fear of making mistakes can be overwhelming at times, affecting my confidence and performance.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: I used an AI-based tutoring app for algebra recently. It provided step-by-step solutions and explanations that helped me understand concepts better, making learning more interactive and less intimidating.
replies.How would you explain, step by step, how: First, write the equation in standard form (ax^2 + bx + c = 0). Calculate the discriminant (b^2 - 4ac) to determine the nature of roots. Use the quadratic formula x = (-b ± √(b^2 - 4ac)) / (2a) to find solutions, simplifying as needed.

To find stationary points, first calculate the derivative dy/dx. Set this equal to zero and solve for x to find critical points. Substitute these back into f(x) to get corresponding y-values. Analyze second derivative to classify as maxima or minima.
